title: Lunar sites: Apollo 11-17 and Artemis III candidate regions
frame: Moon Mean Earth/Polar Axis (DE421), planetocentric; lon east positive, -180..180

sources.apollo: https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/lunar/lunar_sites.html (DE421 ME, from LRO images, Wagner et al. 2017, Icarus 283, 92-103). Lunar Module positions; Apollo 13 did not land.
sources.artemis3_regions: NASA, 'NASA Provides Update on Artemis III Moon Landing Regions' (28 Oct 2024): nine candidate regions near the lunar south pole.
sources.artemis3_positions: https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov (IAU/USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, MOON_nomenclature_center_pts). Precise region polygons: USGS data release McClernan 2024, doi:10.5066/P1MEQ6UK (not machine-accessible from here).

sites.name: Apollo 11
sites.history: First crewed landing on the Moon.

sites.name: Apollo 12
sites.history: Precision landing next to the Surveyor 3 probe.

sites.name: Apollo 14
sites.history: Highland target originally planned for Apollo 13.

sites.name: Apollo 16
sites.history: Only landing in the central lunar highlands.

sites.name: Apollo 17
sites.history: Last crewed landing; first geologist on the Moon.

sites.name: Peak near Cabeus B
sites.note: NASA candidate landing region (Oct 2024). Position = IAU centre of the named feature, NOT the region centre: each region is ~15x15 km and may lie on the feature's rim or slopes.
